resolutions.second_database: World Flora Online plant list, name matching service
resolutions.reason: The article spells the genus 'Ceratocephalus' and describes the plant as a close relative of Ranunculus that accumulates ranunculin. 'Ceratocephalus falcatus (L.) Pers.' is, in both GBIF and World Flora Online, a synonym of the composite Achillea falcata; the buttercup is Ceratocephala falcata (L.) Pers. GBIF accepts Ceratocephala falcata; World Flora Online places it under Ranunculus falcatus. The two databases disagree on the genus, so the GBIF name is used for linking and both are recorded.
